summary: @sbotzakis Pains me to say no. For second year in a row skipping #lra19. After tenure made a commitment to only support organizations that support the commons and open knowledge. Sadly LRA isn't one of those organizations. Decades of talk. No action.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @sbotzakis Pains me to say no. For second year in a row skipping #lra19. After tenure made a commitment to only support organizations that support the commons and open knowledge. Sadly LRA isn't one of those organizations. Decades of talk. No action.
